failure_definition: Transducer array element failure causing image artifacts in an ultrasound system.
current_device_behavior: The ultrasound system generates images of internal body structures using high-frequency sound waves produced by a transducer array.
failure_point: The transducer array elements are exposed to mechanical stress and environmental degradation, leading to premature failure.
blocking_constraint: The physical proximity of the transducer array elements to the operational environment makes it difficult to shield them from mechanical stress and environmental degradation without compromising the device's functionality.
